title: Ashbury Rewards Earning Rules: Elite Bonus of a Completed Stay
content:
## Rule

1. **The stay.** The stay concerned is the stay of the latest base points transaction on the Ashbury Rewards account, and its posted base points are the base points transactions naming it.
2. **Elite bonus base.** The elite bonus base is the stay's posted base points.
3. **Elite bonus percentage.** The elite bonus percentage is the elite bonus percentage of the member's tier.
4. **Elite bonus.** The elite bonus of the stay is the elite bonus base times the elite bonus percentage divided by one hundred, rounded down to a whole point.

## Worked figures (hypothetical stays)

| Tier | Tier's elite bonus percentage, taken as | Posted base points | Product divided by one hundred | Elite bonus |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Gold Elite | 25 | 4123 | 1030.75 | 1030 |
| Ambassador Elite | 75 | 6600 | 4950 | 4950 |
| Silver Elite | 10 | 449 | 44.9 | 44 |

The stay is fixed by the latest base points transaction: when the account shows base points for two stays, the stay whose base points transaction was posted later is the stay concerned.
